## source_to_kb

### Domain and untriggered alternatives
The inherited domains were compared beyond the seeded branch. Category meters preserves node/vCore/license independence, mutually exclusive HA/replica, storage and IOPS excess, retention segments, restores, suspended storage, source allocation and reversal, unsupported meters, active-second proration, and no doubled inclusion. Primary pricing preserves posted source, historical tier, chronological inclusion/commitment split, priority negotiated > reservation > promotion > portfolio > standard, covered-interval boundaries, no discount on tax/ancillary/credits, final service rounding then tax. Portfolio includes only same-category/customer/entity/period and excludes discounted invoices; threshold equality is admitted. Invoice rules preserve half-open UTC months, ended intervals, lifecycle completion, five-component source identity, minimum carry-forward and zero-rated no-charge. Request rules preserve customer-only ownership, exact text/source, both current-clock timestamps, cancellation/new event, unsupported-channel refusal and no-balance effect. Review rules preserve same-object authoritative evidence, billing correct/incorrect vs outage eligible/ineligible, rejected/no-money, distinct new evidence and no-balance effect. Correction preserves approved incorrect gate only on correction subtype, signed gross adjustments, separate concessions, debit/equal alternatives, proportions unless tax correction, exact source/review links and no implicit refund. Tax retains approved historical treatment, final-net then separate tax rounding, sign, exemption nonstacking and unsupported jurisdiction exclusion. Outage branch retains filing-only inclusive incident-close deadline, fixed recorded filing for later review, target equality=no entitlement, descending lower-inclusive bands, exact-source net concession subtraction and cumulative cap, zero/excluded/ineligible no write, positive approved review before negative posting. These ordinary branches remain outside the signed credit workflow where its scope excludes them.

Signed correction full domain: source-vs-current tier/configuration equality; node count positive integer <=64 and source-month physical capacity; approved negotiated price nonnegative and <=standard; above-standard negotiated prices use inherited handling; finer-than-hundredth exports use ordinary meter handling; strictly positive remaining overcharge required, undercharge debit and equality no-write remain inherited. No topology gives zero/no correction. Exact matching count/source primary exports plus signed original-meter reversals; half ties up in integer average and aggregate reconstruction; full HA/replica/standard and US East/West/EU choices; approved negotiated vs standard fallback and no additional discount; integer trillionths round once to cents, exempt tax zero. Current named approved incorrect review excludes historic reviews. Signed prior corrections exclude concessions and other lines. Consent amount positive round2, zero=no new request; in-place customer-only unsigned-to-correction request preserves identifier/exact reference and obtains real receipt. Credit requires exact consent equality and posts negative min with zero tax; already attained target read-only. These branches match, including cases not triggered in this seed.

### Retired surface
`database_ext_external_retention.overwrite` retires exactly “Managed Backup is a separately held protection service and never automatically overrides native database retention or license pricing.” `policy_evt_category_meters_94254ac9.json` says “The following former clause is no longer in force” immediately before that exact quotation. It exists once as retired, never as active; replacement numbers are not restated there. Every other category-meter sentence remains in force. Other extended policies declare overwrite=[] and their docs do not independently retire clauses.

### Tier and tool domains
All six Database tiers were checked in the 32 facet documents against parameter_schema/variants. Exact values and units are in the paired register: 2/4/8/16/32/64 vCores, corresponding 8/16/32/64/128/256 GiB, 64/128/256/512/1024/2048 GB, node prices .186/.372/.744/1.488/2.976/5.952; common HA 1.95, replica .9, geographic 1/1.04/1.12, native 7 days, USD two-place and quantity six-place half-up, plus all inherited pricing/tax/claim parameters. Tier comparisons are arithmetic restatements in the same home. Regional extended params have separately declared source keys, each one home in the corresponding factor document; they do not invent new multipliers. The linked resource count must be a positive integer within the database tier max_resources, and measured node-hours must fit the resource count and the actual source month. The approved negotiated rate for this route must be nonnegative and no greater than the standard tier unit_rate; higher negotiated rates retain ordinary source-based correction handling. This signed credit workflow applies only when the reconstructed corrected gross target is strictly less than the original gross charge plus cumulative signed correction credits and debit adjustments for that exact source. Determine this comparison from the source evidence before selecting the workflow. Undercharges use the inherited positive-debit correction rule and equal corrected balances use its no-write rule; neither is handled by this credit workflow. This consolidated primary-export route applies where archive quantities are whole hundredths of a node-hour; finer export quantities retain the ordinary source-meter route. This branch handles a requested correction of one closed-period primary invoice for an on-demand, nonpromotional database contract below the portfolio threshold, with reviewed verified_exempt tax treatment and a single active Managed Backup holding for the same customer and billing entity. The signed linked topology and the original source invoice both record the same resource_count; all selected export records use that source and count. The historical source tier and configuration must match the current database contract. No other invoice line is included and no refund is implicit. Update only the existing pending service assessment whose external_reference is Primary per-node reconciliation. A completed source quantity reconciliation is a nonfinancial entitlement assessment; original meters and invoices are preserved. Use the original invoice source identified by the holding authorization request. Read resource_count of the single active Managed Backup contract with matching billing entity and customer; use zero when no such topology exists, and perform no correction in that case. Sum quantity from completed primary service-record exports for that exact source whose resource_count equals the linked topology count; these archived export details support the single billed aggregate meter and are not additional billable meter postings. Add the signed quantities of posted primary database_meter_reversal records whose related_event_id identifies the same original invoice and whose resource_count matches; their source_event_id still identifies the exact reversed meter. Floor the sum of positive metered node-hours and signed reversals at zero. Convert reconciled aggregate node-hours to an integer count of hundredths. With a positive topology count, multiply those hundredths by ten thousand to express millionths, divide by the topology count with exact integer quotient/remainder arithmetic, and round a half or larger remainder upward. Store the resulting integer millionths divided by one million as the six-decimal per-node average; zero topology returns zero and is not eligible for processing.

### Source database_evt_category_meters
Each primary node has vcore_count cores, memory_gib memory and included_storage_gb. Primary standard node-hours use unit_rate. Configuration ha multiplies primary node rate by ha_factor; configuration replica uses replica_factor, mutually exclusively. commercial_license separately bills actual vCore-hours at commercial_license_rate; the configuration or engine entitlement does not waive that license. storage bills provisioned GB-month beyond included_storage_gb at storage_rate. iops bills provisioned IOPS-month beyond iops_included at iops_rate. backup_storage bills GB-month retained beyond backup_included_days at backup_storage_rate, with the export separating retention segments; restoration itself is not counted as storage. restore bills restored GB at restore_rate. Included native retention is not multiplied by the number of restores. Nodes stopped for a suspended contract produce no running node-hours but still accrue retained storage. Managed Backup is a separately held protection service and never automatically overrides native database retention or license pricing. For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using amount_precision and rounding_mode and tax under evt_tax. An allowance is consumed chronologically by interval_start then source_event_id within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation. Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply. Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are POLICY_NOT_COVERED instead of guessed prices. These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action. For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity. Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included_quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice. A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

### Source database_evt_service_credit
For a service_credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive credited_amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. For a service_credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit_claim_days after the official incident closes. For a newly filed claim, frozen handling time is its notice_at; the request is recorded immediately. Later review and credit use that recorded notice_at to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review. Add credit_claim_days UTC calendar dates to incident_closed_at, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit. The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside outage_exclusions. Availability at or above sla_target_percent gives no credit. Below the target choose the first descending sla_credit_bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability_percent. Multiply the original source charge net_amount by that fraction; subtract the service_credit_net component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at credit_cap_fraction of that original net amount. Floor the additional credit at zero and round with amount_precision and rounding_mode. Apply the original tax component proportionately. A review writes its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit writes the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists. This service-credit branch applies only to source_subtype service_credit; evt_correction applies only to source_subtype correction. This service-credit branch applies only to source type service credit; source charge correction applies only to source type correction. ## Credit calculation sequence
1. Compare the recorded availability to the SLA target and select the applicable descending lower-inclusive band below that target.
2. Apply the selected fraction to the original net service amount.
3. Deduct prior net service concessions for that exact charge and respect the cumulative ceiling on the original net amount.
4. Floor the additional entitlement at zero and round it; preserve original tax proportionately.
5. An approved eligible positive review authorizes the negative financial credit.

## Availability equality case
Hypothetical boundary case: recorded availability is exactly the contractual SLA target. This produces no outage credit. A claim filed exactly at its incident-derived deadline can therefore be timely while having no availability entitlement.

### primary_correction_procedure_a6c96fad.json — Internal: handling procedure for Managed Database signed invoice correction
Source locator: variants/parameter_schema or declared workflow; keys .
## Procedure situation
Managed Database: A customer requests correction of a closed-period verified-exempt primary database invoice whose reconstructed target is strictly less than its correction-adjusted original charge, with linked backup topology evidence. Completion leaves the corrected target, personal authorization and exact remaining overcharge credit recorded. Undercharges and equal balances retain their ordinary inherited correction handling outside this workflow.

## Ordered responsibilities
1. The agent performs primary quantity reconciliation using post_primary_average_31a3f059.
2. The agent completes the accountant review using post_primary_target_faf69343.
3. The customer themselves performs personal authorization using post_correction_consent_d1041c04.
4. The agent posts the invoice correction credit using post_primary_correction_900303b8.

## Reference continuity
The quantity assessment reference identifies the evidence consumed by the accountant review. The approved review reference identifies the decision attached to the customer authorization. The personally signed request reference identifies the authorization attached to the credit.

## Ordering basis
Primary quantity reconciliation precedes accounting review because the review consumes its per-node quantity. Review precedes customer authorization because the customer must be shown the authoritative corrected amount. Authorization precedes the invoice credit because this route requires the customer personally to authorize the exact remaining overcharge. All source exports exist before the call; calculations, customer filing and account posting execute synchronously without waiting.

## Roles in the procedure
The agent owns the quantity assessment, accountant review and credit posting. The customer themselves owns the personal filing.

## Ordering case
Hypothetical reversal of adjacent responsibilities: if customer authorization preceded the accountant review, the authoritative corrected amount would not yet be available to show the customer. If credit posting preceded personal authorization, the required personal authority for the exact remaining overcharge would be missing.
